specialRules.name: Behavioral Health Services Tax
specialRules.description: An additional 1% tax on taxable income over $1,000,000 (California Proposition 63; renamed the Behavioral Health Services Tax).

citation.sourceDocument: California FTB 2026 California Tax Rate Schedules; 2025 standard deduction (FTB deductions page)
citation.sourceNote: Bracket thresholds are the FTB 2026 California Tax Rate Schedules (Schedule X single/MFS, Schedule Y MFJ/QSS, Schedule Z head of household), the CCPI-indexed 2026 schedule, published in the 2026 Personal Income Tax Booklet. The standard deduction ($5,706 single/MFS, $11,412 MFJ/HoH/QSS) is still the 2025 amount: the FTB deductions page states the 2025 chart, and no 2026 Form 540 booklet is published yet, so it is carried forward and errs slightly low, so tax slightly high (the 2026 amount is indexed by the same CCPI factor, about 3.4%, that moved the brackets). A 2026-DATED FTB document is not a 2026 source for the deduction: the 2026 Form 540-ES worksheet and the EDD's 2026 Method B withholding schedules both restate the prior year's figures. The 1% Behavioral Health Services Tax (Prop 63) applies to taxable income over $1,000,000.
